title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models (Chinchilla)
description: GPT-3 was significantly undertrained. Optimal: 20 tokens per parameter. Chinchilla (70B, 1.4T tokens) outperforms Gopher (280B, 300B tokens). Every LLM training decision made after uses these laws.
authors: Hoffmann, Bordes, Mensch, Cai, Lee, Roux, Millican, Sifre, et al.
